prompt.en: Income tax in India is described as a progressive tax. Explain what progressive taxation means, and state any two public services that income tax pays for.

label.en: A higher income pays tax at a higher rate

level1.en: What happens to the rate as a person's income rises?

clue.en: The slab table moves from nil to 5%, then 10%, then 15% and beyond, so the rate climbs with the income.

level2Template.en: Under progressive taxation, a person with a higher income pays tax at a ___ rate.

label.en: Only the part of the income inside a slab is charged at that rate

level1.en: Is the highest rate charged on the whole income, or only on a part of it?

clue.en: Each slab charges its own rate on the portion of income that falls inside it, so the slabs are added one by one.

level2Template.en: Only the part of the income lying inside a slab is charged at ___ rate.

label.en: Two public services funded by income tax

level1.en: Name two things that the tax money is spent on.

clue.en: The chapter names schools, hospitals, transport and defence, all of which are used without a fee at the gate.

level2Template.en: The tax funds public services such as ___ and ___.

text.en: Income tax in India is progressive, which means that the rate of tax rises as the income rises.
Under progressive taxation, a person with a higher income pays tax at a ___ rate.
Only the part of the income lying inside a slab is charged at ___ rate.
The tax funds public services such as ___ and ___.
